name: Electrosteel Castings Ltd
title: Electrosteel Castings Ltd - 500128 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Ductile iron pipe demand has collapsed as JJM funds froze: Q4 volume down 21% YoY to 1.48 lakh t, FY26 down 25%, with management guiding FY27 dispatch to ~7.4 lakh t pipes and 13-14% EBITDA margin.

utilisation.quote: the industry running at 50% capacity is the new normal

triggers.label: JJM 2.0 outlay raised to INR 8.69 lakh cr
triggers.quote: The budget outlay has been extended to INR 8.69 lakh crores up to December 2028.

triggers.label: Q4 EBITDA margin 6.5% (incl. OI)
triggers.quote: EBITDA including other income for the 4 th Quarter FY26 stood to INR 99.3 crores with EBITDA margin of 6.5%.

triggers.label: Dividend payout cut 140% to 90%
triggers.quote: Board has decided to reduce the d ividend from 140% to 90% subject to shareholders' approval.

triggers.label: Order book 4-5 months
triggers.quote: our order book at the moment is between 4 to 5 months.

guidance.quote: It will be around 7.4 lakh tons, please.

red_flags.label: Standalone Q4 PAT loss; dividend payout cut
red_flags.quote: PAT for the quarter was a loss of INR 10.7 crores

red_flags.label: Cost pressure from war; exceptional labour code cost
red_flags.quote: exceptional cost of around INR 38 -INR 40 crores on account of the new labour rules

evasions.topic: Consolidated FY27 revenue and volume deferral
evasions.quote: Steady traction, sir, not pedal to the metal tract ion.
